home.title: Technology products that make learning, work, and everyday life simpler.
home.lead: ViMai builds careful software for Japanese certification study, children's learning, and daily health. Real products. Clear information. No noise.
home.productsLead: Choose the app that matches the goal: certification, kids' learning, or health.
home.learnBody: Exam-prep products are built around mock tests and a clear study path.
home.workBody: Tools for people preparing to work in Japan, including transport and mechanic certification.
home.liveBody: Health tracking and children's learning for the rest of daily life.
home.pillar1Body: Exam prep should have a clear scope and path. Mock exams are the core of how we help learners get ready.
home.pillar2Body: No visual noise. Information hierarchy first, so people can use the product on day one.
home.pillar3Body: These tools serve people who work and study in Japan, so accuracy and readability come first.
home.feedbackLead: Only approved notes from real people appear here.
home.feedbackEmpty: Be one of the first to share your experience.
home.ctaBody: Contact us about store release dates, deployment, or press.

products.howToStartStep1: Read this page to understand what the product is, who it is for, and the main features.
products.howToStartStep2: Open the ViMai product site when you are ready to try it.
products.howToStartStep3: Download from the App Store or Google Play when the listing is live.

about.title: About
about.lead: ViMai is an education and technology ecosystem. We build trustworthy digital products for people preparing for Japanese certifications, children, and anyone tracking daily health.
about.storyBody: Guided by “Building Vietnam's Future,” ViMai is not only about passing an exam. It is about durable learning and daily wellbeing.
about.scope1: Tokutei Gino exam prep for taxi and transport
about.qualityBody: Facts only where confirmed, readable Japanese, and a calm interface. Unreleased products are labeled clearly; missing details are marked for CMS update.

legal.privacyBody: ViMai collects only what is needed to operate this website: contact form messages, optional feedback you choose to submit, and authentication for administrators. Email addresses from contact or admin login are never shown publicly. Legal entity details will be published here when they are confirmed; they are not invented on this page.
legal.analyticsBody: If Cloudflare Web Analytics is enabled, it is privacy-oriented and does not use advertising cookies. Figures in the admin dashboard are taken from Cloudflare and may be approximate. We do not treat page refreshes as unique people.
legal.feedbackBody: Feedback is optional. Submissions stay private until an administrator approves them. You may omit a rating. Do not include sensitive personal data in the message body.
legal.termsBody: This website describes ViMai products. Store listings, exam requirements, and third-party services remain governed by their own terms. Formal terms of service will be published when the operating entity details are confirmed.
